senses.sense_definition: The ability of different computer systems, software, or products to exchange information and work together seamlessly.

examples.text: The company decided to adopt open standards to ensure full <w>interoperability</w> between its devices and third-party accessories.
A lack of <w>interoperability</w> between medical record databases makes it difficult for hospitals to share critical patient data.

senses.sense_definition: The ability of different military units, allied forces, or organizations to coordinate operations and use each other's equipment effectively.

examples.text: Joint military exercises are essential to enhance the <w>interoperability</w> of allied forces during an international crisis.
The coalition conducted tactical drills to test the <w>interoperability</w> of their communication gear in the field.
